title: Bounded typed trigger onset and envelope execution in SignalGraph

needles: Typed and spectral preparation remain separate admission lanes

installed_sdk.rationale: The host header installation includes trigger_graph.hpp and custom_node_events.hpp. The public consumer executes the admitted framework onset/envelope pair and bounded audio factories against the installed host library. The event-block pointer does not admit arbitrary Custom callbacks as typed producers; preparation refuses opaque Custom state and mixed spectral plans. This is a bounded runtime slice, not full G-5 or realtime qualification.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: This slice adds an in-process C++ SignalGraph runtime seam; no offline timeline command creates or publishes its typed plans.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool is added for typed trigger graph construction or publication.

live_product_control.rationale: The bounded C++ seam has no product-facing typed trigger authoring or publication control. Baked graph exposure and graph topology controls require separate delivery; this row does not claim a musician can reach the new runtime.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: Trigger transport, controller publication, and runtime resource bounds are runtime infrastructure, not a new generator-facing capability. The surface ledger fingerprints the public headers without advertising full G-5 support.
